title: Do Neural Optimal Transport Solvers Work? A Continuous Wasserstein-2 Benchmark
tldr_zh: ICNN 梯度构造有解析真值的连续 W2 基准（至 CelebA64），评测 7 类求解器：多数 map 不准，map 准不等于生成好
tldr_en: ICNN-gradient benchmark pairs with analytic W2 maps up to CelebA64; most neural OT solvers recover maps poorly, and OT accuracy does not predict generative quality.
key_numbers: High-dim benchmark D=256 L2-UVP: MMv1 2.6%, MMv2 2.7%, W2 2.7%, MM 4.1% (diverged late), MM-B 22.5%, LS 54.7%, QC 88.2%, linear baseline 67.4% (Table 2)
CelebA64 cos for QC and MM-B near 0 or negative, i.e. gradient orthogonal to true W2 gradient (Table 3)
Generative modeling: QC gives good samples with wrong map; W2 (ICNN) worst samples; MM / MM:R blurry, T o G comparable to QC (Sec. 4.5, Fig. 5; FID values only in figure)
